claims.claim: Spoken / sighted lat 49 N, lon 23 W (the 16th)
claims.citation: New York Herald, 8 May 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Liverpool, April 23—The Fred H Parker, M'Neill, from St
John (NB), for St Thomas, was abandoned a complete wreck
April 1, in lat 36 N, lon 62 W; crew taken off by the Thetis,
of this port, and transferred on the 16th, in lat 49 N, lon 23
W, to the Harpswell, Wallace, from Havre for NYork.
